links.outcome: Barriers to AI adoption in safety net organizations, including governance structures
links.effect: AI governance structures were among the key barriers reported by the five safety net organizations during Integration and Lifecycle Management phases. No numeric results reported.
links.quote: Key barriers emerged during the Integration and Lifecycle Management phases and included gaps in AI performance evaluation and impact assessments, communication with patients about AI use, foundational AI education, financial resources for purchasing and maintaining AI tools, and AI governance structures.

links.outcome: Gaps in foundational AI education among safety net organization staff
links.effect: Foundational AI education and lack of resources for staff training were identified as key barriers. No numeric results reported.
links.quote: Key barriers emerged during the Integration and Lifecycle Management phases and included gaps in AI performance evaluation and impact assessments, communication with patients about AI use, foundational AI education, financial resources for purchasing and maintaining AI tools, and AI governance structures.

links.outcome: Barriers in communicating with patients about AI use
links.effect: Limited guidance on communicating with patients about AI use was a key barrier for the safety net organizations. No numeric results reported.
links.quote: Key barriers emerged during the Integration and Lifecycle Management phases and included gaps in AI performance evaluation and impact assessments, communication with patients about AI use, foundational AI education, financial resources for purchasing and maintaining AI tools, and AI governance structures.

unlisted_practices: Centralized expertise, structured guidance, and peer learning through a technical assistance program to support AI adoption in safety net organizations

screen.reason: Empirical implementation study of five safety net organizations implementing AI tools over 12 months, identifying barriers and strategies across the AI lifecycle rather than quantitatively testing a specific guardrail intervention.
